---
title: "Optical Radiation Pressure Springs for Metrology"
date: 2019-04-01
categories: [physics, metrology]
description: "A theoretical model using optical radiation pressure for precision force sensing."
image: ../images/RPS.png
---

This theoretical project studied optical radiation pressure as a way to detect small forces and effects such as Casimir forces. The setup used high-intensity lasers and highly reflective mirrors to create measurable changes in interference patterns.
